title: HyperCore
description: The Core for HyperCharging your server!
body:
###
About HyperCore
HyperCore itself is only a gateway to the world of Hyper Suite. It serves as a core library engine for the other plugins to perform their tasks. It provides all the necessary libraries and methods to all HyperPlugins by developer peetfoxx.
---

###
Why Hyper?
You may find many similar plugins on the internet, so asking this question is on point. HyperPlugins aim to deliver the best quality, cover various features, and support all kinds and sizes of servers. My personal problem with mainstream plugins was that they lacked customizability and did not support larger server networks. Instead of focusing solely on small server owners, HyperPlugins offers great scalability with full support and synchronization for larger networks, prioritizing performance.
--- ###
Plugins Using HyperCore
- [HyperLevels](https://polymart.org/product/8869/hyperlevels-levelling-system) - Advanced Levelling System plugin with customizable levels, rewards, prestiges, multipliers etc.
